lines: Hence indeed for the dead's sake installation elsewhere was enjoined;
that here in śāstras not to be done, to be done common again.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ata eva mṛtasyārthe pratiṣṭhānyatra yoditā sātra śāstreṣu no kāryā kāryā sādhāraṇī punaḥ
